def rule(t, A):
    """the last known hump's amplitude is < 1/4 of the opposite move over the 60 bars before it (a micro wiggle flipped the side)."""
    k, side = t["k"], t["side"]
    H = A.humps_known(k)
    if not len(H):
        return False
    b0, v0, bh, vh, b1, v1, tr, kn = H[-1]
    amp = vh - min(v0, v1)
    lo = int(max(b0 - 60, 0)); seg_h = A.h[lo:int(b0) + 1]; seg_l = A.l[lo:int(b0) + 1]
    if side > 0:      # green camel after a drop: the drop from the 60-bar high into the hump start
        opp = float(np.max(seg_h)) - v0
    else:             # red camel after a rally
        opp = vh - float(np.min(seg_l))
    return opp > 4 * amp and opp > 8 * A.PIP

losses.comment: Thu 15:50 UTC (20:50 PKT). EUR/USD topped 1.1487 at 20:00 PKT and then printed 50 min of lower highs (1.1483, 1.1481, 1.1478) and lower lows down to 1.1471 at 20:42: a 16-pip leg down. The camel flipped GREEN x2 on two ~2-pip micro humps of the 5-pip bounce off 1.1471 - the micro hump does not change the 60-bar structure (still lower highs, level at 33% of the 60-bar range, 11 pips under the hour's high). The level 1.14765 is the high of a red UHV (20:38, 247 ticks) that sits on the descending row of lower highs (20:36 ~1.1477), so the buy was into the last lower high of a falling market; it filled 0.4 pip over the level at the exact top of the bounce, never printed higher and bled 25 pips to the stop over ~2 h. Twins: 19:49 bought a break out of a higher-low base and ran 10 pips; 19:25 bought inside a choppy range, went 3 pips against but got its tick first. Visible before entry: counter-structure buy (bounce after a 16-pip drop) - but the population table shows position-in-range / prior-opposing-move are NOT selective in general, so this one is mostly bad luck at the micro level.

Fri 17:26 UTC (22:26 PKT), last 3.5 h before the weekend close. A slow Friday grind higher (higher lows 1.1462 -> 1.1464 -> 1.1467 between 21:20 and 22:13 PKT) on a thin tape (30-min average 62 ticks/min against 90-110 three hours earlier). The camel went RED x1 on the 22:05-22:13 pullback; the sell level 1.14686 is the low of the green UHV (22:19, only 105 ticks) 1.6 pips under the retracement high. Sold 1.14684 at the bottom of the pullback: the market never traded lower, crept back up to 1.1476 and the round was closed by the Friday close (why 8, -65$). Twins (same day 19:53 and 19:58 PKT) were ALSO sells against the rising market, but in a busy tape (UHV 123/285 ticks, 104/218 breakout ticks) where the 0.1 pip came instantly before the rally. What separates it: Friday afternoon + thin tape - a quiet, one-way drift gives no counter-tick; the population confirms Friday (lift 1.5) and the thinnest 10% of 30-min volume (lift 1.7).

Thu 04:26 UTC (09:26 PKT, Tokyo). After a 9-pip rise from 1.1362 the market went flat for 35 min in a 2-pip box with a hard ceiling at 1.1370-1.1371, tested at 08:51, 09:15 and 09:22 PKT. The red UHV (09:24) carried only 51 ticks and the level 1.13703 is 0.7 pip under the box top; the retracement was 0.7 pip deep. Thin Asian tape: 30-min average 52 ticks/min, 0.57x the 4-hour average. Bought the fourth test of the ceiling at 1.13708, never printed higher, fell out of the box. Twin 09:11 PKT bought the SAME ceiling (1.13707) 15 min earlier and won by a single tick; twin 08:58 bought a pullback. Visible before entry: a repeatedly rejected flat ceiling in a thin, stalling market - but the twin shows the same picture can still win by one tick.

Mon 06:05:00 UTC (11:05 PKT, Frankfurt open). A clean 14-pip climb from 1.1381 to 1.1395 in 55 min with higher lows all the way (mom60 = 8.4 pips AGAINST the sell). At the top a 12-minute stall with a volume burst (the green UHV at 11:01 had 195 ticks, the loudest bar on the chart). The camel went RED x2 on 1-2 pip wiggles inside that stall, so the 'downtrend' was two micro humps at the top of an uptrend. Sold in the very first second of the minute (4 breakout ticks) at 1.13929, the low of the stall; the market never traded lower and ground up to 1.1400+. Twins 13:38/13:44 PKT sold WITH a clean 60-bar downtrend (mom60 +7.5/+8.2 in favour). Visible: counter-trend sell, the red camel being a micro hump after a 14-pip impulse.
